summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of new /admin/* portal. Tested auth guard, login, AdminLayout sidebar, AdminOverview (8 KPIs + 2 recharts + 4 quick actions + recent lists), AdminPickups filters + table, AdminPickupDetails (7 sections), Assign/Reassign dialog flow (BC-9104 Vikram→Rajesh), AdminExecutives list + filters, Create-executive dialog (TEST_Auto Exec added at top), exec status toggle (Disable↔Enable), AdminExecutiveDetails 6 stat cards, AdminCustomers (12 rows) + filters, AdminCustomerDetails 4 stat cards + history, AdminProfile 4 tabs, cookie banner suppressed on /admin/*, mobile 390px hamburger + pickup cards, logout dialog confirm clears auth and redirects, regression on /, /login, /dashboard/overview, /executive. ~55+ assertions, ~95% pass rate. Only minor finding: AdminProfile uses read-only fields by default with an Edit toggle and the profile-name-input testid is not exposed until Edit mode is entered (testid for the edit button itself was not located by simple selector).
action_items: Minor: AdminProfile.jsx — expose data-testid='profile-edit-toggle' (or similar) on the Edit button, and ensure data-testid='profile-name-input' / 'profile-save' remain stable in edit mode for future automated regression coverage. Not a functional bug.

Optional: in CreateExecutiveDialog the autogenerated empId/password show as input values (verified visually); add data-testid='exec-form-temp-password-display' if you want to assert on the generated password chip.
critical_code_review_comments: adminMock.js is 1264 lines — borderline acceptable for a mock-data module, but consider splitting seed data (pickups/executives/customers) into separate fixture files to keep this file under ~700 lines for maintainability.
adminMock.js `clearAdminLocal` intentionally preserves pickups/execs/customers across signout — make sure this is the desired UX (it is, per PRD: 'so demo data survives').

AssignExecutiveDialog confirm button testid is `assign-confirm` (PRD/test plan mentioned `assign-exec-save`). Naming is internally consistent (assign-cancel/assign-confirm) but doc drift is worth fixing in test plan or testid.
CreateExecutiveDialog field testids use `exec-form-*` prefix (not `create-exec-*`); same doc-drift note.
test_credentials: Demo admin: admin@bincycle.in / admin123 (lenient — any creds accepted). No backend involved.
seed_data_creation: Created via localStorage on first load: 8 execs, 12 customers, 16 pickups (including BC-9101..BC-9106, BC-9087, BC-9078, etc.). Test also added TEST_Auto Exec via UI and a reassignment history entry on BC-9104 (both persisted to localStorage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin portal at /admin/* is fully functional. Key testids verified: admin-login-{page,form,email,password,submit}, admin-{sidebar,topbar,brand,sidebar-user,sidebar-signout,sidebar-profile,mobile-menu}, admin-nav-{overview,pickups,executives,customers,profile}, kpi-{total-pickups,pending,in-progress,completed,customers,executives,revenue,todays-collections}, chart-{volume,status-distribution}, qa-{pickups,execs,customers,profile}, overview-{pickup,customer,exec}-{id}, link-all-{pickups,customers,execs}, pickups-{search,filter-status,filter-date,filter-exec,filter-customer,result-count,clear-filters,table-wrap}, pickup-row-{id}, pickup-card-{id}, booking-info, customer-info, executive-info, pickup-timeline, completion-details, uploaded-images, assignment-history, open-assign-dialog, assign-exec-dialog, assign-exec-select, assign-cancel, assign-confirm, execs-{search,filter-status,filter-zone}, open-create-exec, create-exec-dialog, create-exec-form, exec-form-{name,empid,email,phone,zone,vehicle,password,show-pwd,regen-pwd,cancel,submit}, toggle-exec-{id}, exec-status-{id}, exec-stat-*, cust-stat-*, customer-row-{id}, admin-tab-{profile,notifications,security,preferences}, admin-logout-{dialog,cancel,confirm}.
